blocks.text: Responsive image sources let the browser choose a suitable image size. A small screen should not always need the largest file.

Use a local test page and browser developer tools. Code samples show a page choice or a measurement. Compare before and after under the same conditions; exact timings depend on the device and network.

blocks.title: Offer an image that fits

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `srcset` lists alternative image files and their real widths. `sizes` describes the layout space the image will occupy.

blocks.text: With real image files at those widths, the browser chooses a source using the layout size and display density.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: The widths in srcset must match the real files. The sizes hint should match the actual layout.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Compare the chosen image request at two viewport sizes.
